SELECT distinct max(a.fin_statement_hd_id) as fin_statement_hd_id, max(a.bp_id) as bp_id, max(b.fin_statement_templet_name) as fin_statement_templet_name, max(a.CREATION_DATE) as CREATION_DATE, a.fin_statement_templet_hd_id as fin_statement_templet_hd_id, max(a.check_status) as check_status
FROM hls_fin_statement_hd a LEFT JOIN hls_fin_statement_tmplt_hd b ON a.fin_statement_templet_hd_id = b.fin_statement_templet_hd_id
1=1
and a.bp_id=#{bpId}
group by a.bp_id ,a.fin_statement_templet_hd_id , a.header_id

SELECT distinct a.fiscal_year year FROM hls_fin_statement_hd a LEFT JOIN hls_fin_statement_tmplt_hd b ON a.fin_statement_templet_hd_id=b.fin_statement_templet_hd_id
1=1
and a.bp_id=#{bpId}
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC

SELECT max(distinct header_id) as header_id FROM hls_fin_statement_hd
1=1
and bp_id= #{bpId}
group by bp_id
